notes: The Plan tab's monthly take-home now counts flat per-check fees at your real pay schedule: a biweekly check carries one fee for two weeks, a monthly check one fee a month. Before, the planner counted the fee every week, so biweekly pay showed too low versus the Paycheck tab — and the Plan goal date came out later than the Budget tab's for the same week. Weekly pay and weeks with no flat fees are unchanged.
